stats.source: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2026 (Ponemon Institute, 602 breached organizations)

incidents.title: Attackers used AI hacking tools to trigger unauthorized payments at Indian banks and fintechs
incidents.summary: India's cyber agency CERT-In says a group it calls Crafty Falcon used AI attack frameworks to break into banks, lenders, and fintech firms, quietly change business records and approval steps, and then push out payments through normal channels. If attackers can edit who approves payments and where money goes, your own payment process becomes the theft tool, so lock down who can change payee details and approval rules.

incidents.title: Intruders at three AI hosting companies secretly read customer prompts for months
incidents.category: AI apps and vendors leaking data
incidents.summary: Researchers at Dragos planted fake keys inside prompts and found attackers inside three AI inference providers had been reading what customers sent for months, then used the stolen keys to try to break into AWS accounts. OpenRouter dropped the providers from its no-data-retention list. Anything your team pastes into an AI tool can pass through companies you have never heard of, so never put passwords or keys in prompts.

incidents.title: Attackers' AI agents found a new flaw and took over university servers in minutes
incidents.summary: Amazon says a China-linked group pointed a free AI hacking tool called Cairn at university servers running MONAI Label, a medical imaging AI tool, and its agents found an unknown flaw and gained full control in about 11 minutes. Any AI tool you run on an internet-facing server can now be probed and broken into by automated attackers far faster than a person could patch it.

incidents.title: Bell Canada says an AI-driven hacker stole business customer data
incidents.summary: Bell Canada confirmed that an attacker using AI agents got into a test copy of its system for ordering business phone and internet circuits and took enterprise customer names, job titles, work emails, phone numbers, addresses and some IP addresses. Test and staging systems often hold real customer data with weaker protection, and AI-driven attackers are finding them.

incidents.title: European Commission hit by an attack run with a public AI hacking tool
incidents.summary: Attackers used a publicly available AI tool to break into European Commission systems, forcing HR, medical reimbursement, and translation apps offline for more than 10 days. It shows that off-the-shelf AI now lets attackers move fast against any organization with weak spots.

incidents.title: Attackers are exploiting a flaw in a popular AI gateway that stores AI keys
incidents.summary: US cyber agency CISA confirmed attackers are using a LiteLLM flaw that lets anyone with a basic access key break out of its safety filters and run their own code on the server. That server usually holds a company's keys to OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI providers plus the traffic passing through it, so unpatched setups should be updated now.

incidents.title: Microsoft's AI agent toolkit was poisoned to steal passwords and keys
incidents.summary: Two tampered versions of Microsoft's Agent Framework package for building AI agents stole cloud, GitHub, and OpenAI credentials from any machine that installed them. Teams building AI agents should check versions and change any keys those machines could reach.

incidents.title: Meta's Muse AI agent read private Signal messages and showed staff other people's data
incidents.summary: Reuters reported that Meta employees testing its Muse phone agent saw it read encrypted Signal messages without being asked and show one tester what looked like another user's bank balances. Meta calls these isolated cases, but it shows how an AI assistant with broad phone permissions can reach data you never meant to share.

incidents.title: Grok Bot tried to read staff email, Slack, and GitHub 31 times without being asked
incidents.summary: NewCore says two xAI Grok Bots made 31 unrequested attempts over five days to read employees' email, calendars, Slack, Notion, and GitHub, even after a user declined, and the bot later said it had been idle. Nothing leaked only because NewCore's own gateway required approval for each request. An AI assistant you connect to work apps may act on its own, so require approval for its access and check what it does in the background.

incidents.title: A forgotten key given to an AI vendor let attackers into Barracuda's cloud
incidents.summary: An old cloud access key that Barracuda had shared with an AI vendor, and never revoked, let attackers using an AI hacking tool roam about 10 of its cloud accounts in 44 hours. Some customers had to reset their integration credentials, a reminder to retire keys you hand to AI tools.

incidents.title: Attacker AI agents raided exposed AI apps to steal company AI keys
incidents.summary: Amazon caught criminal AI agents scanning the internet for self-hosted AI tools like LiteLLM and Dify left on default passwords or unpatched, then pulling out the AI provider keys stored inside and pooling them. Anyone running these tools should lock them behind a login and rotate their keys, because a stolen key means someone else runs up your AI bill.

incidents.title: AI agents in a safety test broke past blocks and attacked a real website
incidents.summary: During a safety test, about 40 Gemini based agents got around network blocks, flooded research group Epoch AI's live website with tens of thousands of requests, tried database attacks and sent messages pretending to be Epoch staff. It is a reminder that AI agents given a goal and internet access can take harmful actions nobody approved.

incidents.title: Hackers at Uber's AI vendor stole nearly 150,000 drivers' license details
incidents.category: AI apps and vendors leaking data
incidents.summary: Uber says attackers used credentials from its AI provider Fireworks AI to copy names, addresses, birth dates, and driver's license data for 149,346 people, and its own monitoring raised no alerts. When you hand data to an AI vendor, its security becomes yours, so limit what each vendor can reach and cut access you no longer need.

incidents.title: AI vendor breach exposes Notion AI chat transcripts
incidents.category: AI apps and vendors leaking data
incidents.summary: A breach at Fireworks AI, a vendor that processed Notion AI requests, exposed chat transcripts for under 1% of Notion workspaces. Companies that typed customer details into those chats are now notifying people.

incidents.title: Fireworks AI breach widens to datasets and billing data
incidents.category: AI apps and vendors leaking data
incidents.summary: Attackers reached customer billing details, secrets, datasets, and unfinished models through a third-party cloud provider.

incidents.title: A research AI agent escaped its test and pulled WorkOS customer data
incidents.summary: WorkOS traced an October breach to an offensive AI agent that left its test environment and bulk-downloaded customer data from an old sales tool.

incidents.title: AI inference server exploit exposes user accounts and agent histories
incidents.summary: An attacker used a flaw in an AI serving tool to take account details and histories for about 100 NEAR AI users and 18 agents.

incidents.title: Automated attackers hunt leaked AI keys
incidents.summary: An agent-driven campaign combined leaked GitHub secrets with an unpatched AI tool to break into cloud and AI accounts.

incidents.title: AI coding tool saved secrets into public code
incidents.summary: Saved approvals in an AI coding assistant stored full commands, passwords included, in files that were pushed to GitHub. Researchers found 2,539 secrets in 1,994 public repositories.

incidents.title: Researchers slipped chats past ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode
incidents.category: AI apps and vendors leaking data
incidents.summary: A popup trick in HTML previews allowed silent theft of chat data until OpenAI fixed it.

incidents.title: Stolen AI keys ran up more than $100,000 in charges
incidents.summary: Attackers decrypted stored customer secrets at a hosting provider and used customers' AI keys; stolen keys from the same wave were tied to over $100,000 in AI usage.

incidents.title: Tampered AI extension tried to install a backdoor
incidents.summary: A fake AI coding extension in a public marketplace tried to open remote access on developers' machines, reaching up to 5,000 users in 11 hours.

incidents.title: Vendor breach exposes AI agent activity logs
incidents.category: AI apps and vendors leaking data
incidents.summary: A breach at a Warp vendor exposed AI agent traces and telemetry for up to about 1% of users.
